subject: Outreach renewal: license true-up, PO timeline, and risk mitigation
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@outreach.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kira Singh <kira.singh@outreach.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal notice + initial quote for Redwood Inference (account OUT-2026-0923)

Hi Soojin,

Hope you're well — reaching out to start the renewal conversation for Redwood's Outreach instance. Your current term expires 2026-11-30. I attached the initial renewal quote and a seat breakdown (Outreach_Renewal_Quote_v1.pdf).

Highlights:
- 250 seats renewed for 12 months at the existing enterprise tier
- 10% volume discount reflected on quote; additional discount possible with multi-year commit
- Proposed go-live (renewal effect) date: 2026-12-01

Two items I want to call out given past conversations:
1) You asked about seat true-up flexibility — we can include a quarterly true-up clause with a cap rate; see page 3.
2) Security evidence and SOC2 summary available on request.

Can we schedule a 30-minute procurement sync this week to lock pricing and PO timing? I can also get Legal on the thread for any SOW/contract redlines.

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Park
Senior Account Executive, Outreach
olivia.park@outreach.io | +1 415-555-0132

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@outreach.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice + initial quote for Redwood Inference (account OUT-2026-0923)

Olivia — thanks for the quote and ping. Quick questions before we sync:

- Can you provide a per-seat breakdown by user type (AE, SDR, CSM)? We want to see if we can shift 40 seats to a lighter seat type.
- For the quarterly true-up, what is the cap percentage you typically propose (we'd prefer <= 8% per quarter).
- We need the standard security questionnaire filled (can be the Security_QA_Form.xlsx). Please confirm SOC2 scope and whether you support customer-managed key options.

Ben — copying you to confirm headcount forecasts and seat reclassifications. Marissa — can you confirm procurement timeline (we'd like PO by Oct 31 to avoid procurement backlog).

If you have an updated license schedule we can review quickly, please attach.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | x4123

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal notice + initial quote for Redwood Inference (account OUT-2026-0923)

Soojin — I pulled the seat forecast and we can shift ~35 seats from AE (full) to AE-lite for the coming year (mostly junior AEs). Forecast attached (License_Schedule_v2.xlsx). That should reduce base cost by ~6.5% before discounts.

Procurement timeline (internal):
- Marissa to submit PO request by 2026-10-28
- Finance to confirm and issue PO by 2026-11-02
- Legal to sign contract by 2026-11-05 (assuming no major redlines)

Notes/asks for Outreach: please supply:
- Final per-seat pricing with the AE-lite line item
- Confirmation of quarterly true-up cap (target <=8%)
- Completed security questionnaire (Security_QA_Form.xlsx)

I'll stand up a short Slack thread once the updated quote is in so we can expedite approvals.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
GTM Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@outreach.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kira Singh <kira.singh@outreach.io>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 15:21:00 -0700
Subject: Revised quote + security pack attached (OUT-2026-0923)

Hi Soojin/Ben — thanks for the clarity. Attached are: revised quote with AE-lite line item (Outreach_Renewal_Quote_v1.pdf updated), license schedule (License_Schedule_v2.xlsx), and the security questionnaire (Security_QA_Form.xlsx).

Key updates:
- AE-lite line item: 35 seats at $85/mo (annual billing)
- Quarterly true-up: capped at 7.5% per quarter, annual true-up aggregate capped at 12%
- Additional 3% loyalty discount applied to the final total if we sign before 2026-11-01

DocuSign route: https://www.docusign.net/transaction/ABC12345DEF (quote + standard T&C). I'll leave Kira on copy if Legal/Procurement require the full contract redline pack.

Let me know if the cap and the AE-lite pricing work and I can update the DocuSign so we can get PO and signatures.

Best,
Olivia
Senior Account Executive, Outreach

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@outreach.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Revised quote + security pack attached (OUT-2026-0923)

Thanks — that looks good and appreciated for the quick turnaround.

Confirming next steps from Redwood side:
1) Marissa will submit the PO request today with the AE-lite allocation reflected.
2) Lauren (cc'd) — can you confirm Finance can prioritize this to hit the 11/01 signature deadline to capture the 3% loyalty discount? Also confirming we have the budget headroom for the adjusted total.
3) Ben will review the contract redlines once Kira/Legal provides the packet; Ben, please flag any operational terms we need adjusted (API access, data retention defaults).

Olivia — please proceed to update the DocuSign to reflect the AE-lite seats and the 7.5% quarterly cap. We'll target PO issuance by 2026-10-31 and signature the first week of November. Attach SOW draft if you have one (SOW_Draft.docx) so Legal can expedite.

Appreciate the flexibility on the true-up cap — that was a major ask from our side.

— Soojin
Director, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
